# Entre variáveis qualitativas

## Escala Likert


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
data("pisaitems")

pisaitems <- pisaitems |> 
  select(starts_with("ST24Q"))

perguntas <- c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q5", "Q6", "Q7", "Q8", "Q9", "Q10", "Q11")

names(pisaitems) <- perguntas

pisaitems[, names(pisaitems)] <- lapply(pisaitems[, names(pisaitems)], 
                                        factor,
                                        levels = levels(pisaitems[[1]]),
                                        labels = c("Discordo totalmente",
                                                   "Discordo",
                                                   "Concordo",
                                                   "Concordo totalmente"
                                                   ),
                                        ordered = TRUE
                                        )

dados <- likert(pisaitems)

likert.bar.plot(dados)+
  labs(y = "Porcentagem")
```
